reference.method: Cells at HoustonNet GPS stations with at least 10 years of data and a published vertical rate within ±1 mm/yr; every other such station is held out for checking

gps_validation.method: GPS vertical rate × cos(incidence) compared with OPERA LOS velocity at the nearest OPERA cell within 1 km.
limitations: Approximate only: ignores horizontal GPS motion, uses one assumed incidence angle, and GPS windows are longer than the OPERA 2016-2021 window.
This is a sanity check of the provisional reference, not a formal validation.
Stations used to define the reference are excluded from this comparison.

opera: LOS velocity, not vertical subsidence. Positive = toward the satellite.
Standard error assumes independent residuals; real uncertainty is larger (temporal correlation, seasonal clay motion).
The reference patch is provisional and unreviewed; a moving reference biases every velocity.
A cell is included only if it passes valid-fraction and water checks in every product.
Provisional: reference region and processing choices have not yet been reviewed by the team.
nisar: NISAR data in this artifact is one pairwise LOS observation, not an annual rate.
No pair-signal threshold is applied until an independently justified stable-reference region is supplied.
HoustonNet values are historic context and are not time-matched validation of the NISAR pair.
FEMA context is sampled at the aggregated NISAR-cell center and is not flood depth, parcel advice, or a forecast.
OPERA historical values, when present, are a single 2016 pairwise LOS context field; they are not an annual historical trend or a direct validation of NISAR.
A best-fit plane was removed from each pair (deramp) before referencing; this removes long-wavelength ionospheric/atmospheric ramps and any real frame-wide planar motion.
